title: Shin Seiki Evangelion: 2nd Impression
native_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン ～セカンド・インプレッション～
overview:
There are irregularities in everything. They're all events within a correctable range.... I'm sorry..... Do something about that avoid-trouble-at-all-costs personality of yours! Somehow, apologizing seems to be a habit of mine. That girl... she might be like me..... Perhaps we are alike. And God created man in his own image. Because I don't get hungry. I'll try trusting you for once, Shinji. I'm wide awake, I can't sleep. Is it about a girl you like? Am I... crying? All right!! The Earth Defense Band is back together! Hurry. The battlefield is right in the middle of the city! There's... something inside me. It's growing. I mustn't run away! In the end, maybe everyone is a liar. To others, and to themselves. After all, that's all it's worth. Something like the truth.....

A dramatic adventure based on the Neon Genesis Evangelion anime. A quiet, bookish transfer student, Mayumi Yamagishi, joins Shinji's class in Tokyo-3, and Shinji tries to overcome his shyness and befriend her. Meanwhile a new Angel, one that grows through larval, pupal and adult stages, threatens the city.

Choose what Shinji says to Mayumi and his classmates, and the story develops in different ways depending on how you play. Original animated movies tell the story, and the Evas and Angels battle in real-time polygon scenes with motion-captured movement.

- New original character Mayumi Yamagishi
- Original anime footage made for the game
- Bonus single CD with original songs, including one by the Earth Defense Band
- Memory backup

何事にも、イレギュラーはある。全て修正可能な範囲の出来事だよ…。ごめん……。アンタのその事なかれ主義の性格、何とかしなさいよ！何だか、謝るの、クセみたいで。あの子……僕に似ているのかもしれない……。私たち、似ているのかも知れませんね。そして神は、自分の姿に似せて人を創った。お腹、空かないから。たまには信用してみるわよ、シンジ。目が冴えて、眠れないや。好きな女の子のことじゃない？私、泣いてるの？よっしゃ!!地球防衛バンド再びやな！急がせて。戦場は市街のド真ん中よ！私の中に…何かがいる。成長しているのよ。逃げちゃ駄目なんだ！結局は、みんな嘘付きなのかもね。他人にも、自分にも。所詮、その程度の価値しかないのだよ。真実などという物にはな……。
